acceptance.evidence: red at base 967118d: 13510798882111492 against the oracle's 13510798882111491 in all six edges; cause: wythoff.ts toNumber wrote each bigint entry through Number() with no check; fix: an entry that is not a safe integer throws EngineOverflow (CONTRACTS 2.4 types the entries as number; same rule as SafeInt and symbolicPlay); green 4 passed; the boundary test is exact at 3r = 9007199254740990 on Big and throws at r + 1; commit 5a450a5

acceptance.item: P4-RT-01-02: symmetrizer, gram, cartanClass, classify, smallestNonfiniteSubboard and every guarded function throw RangeError on a road count beyond 2^53 (raised to major by both verifiers; original minor)
acceptance.evidence: red at base: 7 failed | 2 passed, RangeError: the numerator -9007199254740992 is not a safe integer; cause: symmetrizer and gram built rationals with rat(number), which accepts only safe integers; fix: entries go into the rationals through BigInt (rat's own rule in P1-A1 kept); green 14 passed, including a balanced chain, a board in two pieces with symmetrizer entry 2^53/3, an unbalanced board, a one-way board, formValue, and NotFiniteType from coxeterNumber, weylOrder and wythoffEdges; values from the oracle; reverting the fix fails 11; commit ad14092 (comment wording 74763cf)

acceptance.item: P4-RT-03-02: orbitGraph's fast path hashes positions linearly mod 2^30, so an orbit inside 2^30 Z^n becomes quadratic (minor)
acceptance.test: packages/engine/test/unit/search-hash-sublattice.test.ts (4 tests: the adopted timing test, two comparison counts, fast vs generic equality)
acceptance.evidence: red at base: fast 16884 ms vs generic 657 ms; cause: each entry's share of the hash was linear in the entry, so every position in 2^30 Z^n had one hash; fix: each entry's low 32 bits and the rest mixed by the MurmurHash3 finaliser, summed mod 2^30 and still updated incrementally, positions still compared entry by entry; green 4 passed; with the linear share restored: 3 failed (one bucket of 40000, 799980000 comparisons); E8 from 2^30 rho at cap 40000 now 39999 hashes; fast path equals the generic loop on the colliding seeds in both games, both arithmetics, layer bounds, legal play and a handover past 2^53; golden layer_growth green; benchmarks unchanged within noise (warm 1.94 vs 1.60 ms); commit 2bf126f

acceptance.item: P4-RT-11-02: The 25 ms orbit benchmark of SPEC 7.6 no longer measures Big arithmetic: the bigint loop can become 30 times slower and orbit.bench.ts stays green (major)
acceptance.evidence: fixed thing: the 25 ms threshold of SPEC 7.6 / CONTRACTS.md 3 for orbit.bench.ts. A second case was written: same board, seeds times 2^60, same 2000 positions, bigint loop, 25 ms. It catches F9 (588.54 ms). But on this machine it does not stay under 25 ms. Medians at load ~2 (quietest in about 50 minutes): 31.84, 24.29, 30.02 ms. At ~4.5: 29.12, 22.81, 21.60 ms. At 10 to 15: 22.9 to 40.5 ms. In one process it takes 19.5 to 21 ms warm, identical on base and branch. So the case is not committed and the threshold is unchanged. Options: (a) speed up the bigint loop, then add the case at 25 ms; (b) the owner reads 'in Big arithmetic' as naming the board and sets a line for the bigint case; (c) commit the case and let GATE measure it alone. Recommendation (a). The record of what the benchmark measures, plus the exact edit, is in decisions/RT-FIX-P4-engine.md (commit 68347ac).
